title: How Apple's Visionary Macintosh Rewrote the PC Playbook | PCMag
summary: Apple's Macintosh, introduced in 1984, played a pivotal role in the personal computing revolution, despite initial struggles with sales and internal company conflict. The Mac's user-friendly interface and integrated software laid the groundwork for the future of desktop publishing and computing.
sentiment_reason: The Macintosh's introduction marked a significant innovation in personal computing, leading to the growth of the desktop publishing industry and setting Apple on a path to become a tech giant.
